Trigger.Name: WHEN_VALIDATE_RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 counter NUMBER;
 chk number;
BEGIN
-- message('in validate record status:'||:system.record_status||' counter :'||to_char(counter));
-- pause;
 IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT','CHANGED')
 THEN

 INTO counter

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 END IF;
END;

PACKAGE toolbar IS

-- tbscale NUMBER := 40; -- good for 640x480 (VGA)

 PROCEDURE set_timer;

ProgramUnit.Name: TOOLBAR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PACKAGE BODY TOOLBAR IS

 cs VARCHAR2(20);
 csscale NUMBER;

 PROCEDURE hide_function IS
 BEGIN
 Set_Item_Property('banner.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_OFF);
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 END; /* hide_function */

 PROCEDURE set_timer IS
 t Timer;
 BEGIN
 :banner.system_name := :SYSTEM.MOUSE_ITEM;
 IF NOT Id_Null(Find_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR')) THEN
 Delete_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR');
 END IF;
 t := Create_Timer('ENTER_TOOLBAR',250,NO_REPEAT);
 END; /* set_timer */

 PROCEDURE show_function IS
 w NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 :toolbar.Text := Get_Item_Property(item_name, LABEL);
 w := dll.tblen(:toolbar.text)*tbscale/100000*csscale;
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',WIDTH,w);
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',POSITION,
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,X_POS)),
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,Y_POS)) +
 to_number(Get_Item_Property(item_name,HEIGHT)));
 Set_Item_Property('TOOLBAR.TEXT',DISPLAYED,PROPERTY_ON);
 END; /* show_function */

BEGIN

 cs := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),COORDINATE_SYSTEM);
 IF cs = 'INCHES' THEN csscale := 1;
 ELSIF cs = 'PIXELS' THEN csscale := 120;
 ELSIF cs = 'POINTS' THEN csscale := 72;
 ELSIF cs = 'CENTIMETERS' THEN csscale := 2.56;
 ELSIF cs = 'CHARACTER_CELL' THEN
 csscale := Get_Form_Property(Get_Application_Property(CURRENT_FORM_NAME),CHARACTER_CELL_WIDTH);
 csscale := 140/csscale;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_ITEM_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_item_check IS
chk number;
begin
 IF :vdpc_block.donation_type is not null and :vdpc_block.procedure_code is not null 
 THEN
 check_insert_rg('RG_VDPC','C05C05',
 :VDPC_BLOCK.DONATION_TYPE||','||:VDPC_BLOCK.PROCEDURE_CODE||',','C',chk);
 if chk = 1 
 then
 --message('Err: Duplicate Value Entered.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('0319');
 else

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.procedure_code != :vdpc_block.procedure_code or
 :global.donation_type != :vdpc_block.donation_type then
 check_insert_rg('RG_VDPC','C05C05',
 :global.DONATION_TYPE||','||:global.PROCEDURE_CODE||',','D',chk);
 
 end if;
IF :global.procedure_code = :vdpc_block.procedure_code and
 :global.donation_type = :vdpc_block.donation_type 
THEN
 null;
ELSE 
 if :vdpc_block.procedure_code is not null and
 :vdpc_block.donation_type is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_donproc_codes
 WHERE procedure_code = :vdpc_block.procedure_code and
 donation_type = :vdpc_block.donation_type;

 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('RG_VDPC','C05C05',
 :VDPC_BLOCK.DONATION_TYPE||','||:VDPC_BLOCK.PROCEDURE_CODE||',','U',chk);

 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else
 check_insert_rg('RG_VDPC','C05C05',
 :VDPC_BLOCK.DONATION_TYPE||','||:VDPC_BLOCK.PROCEDURE_CODE||',','U',chk);
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
 end if; /* 1st if then */
END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates(eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2) IS
 dt_chk boolean;
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 
 -- IM 512
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- IM 512

 if eff_date < trunc(chp_sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then -- IM 512
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date, term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 if term_date < trunc(chp_sysdate) then -- IM 512
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 
 end if;
end;
